biggest_catch: The headline is an average, not a promise: 3-10 days covers document approval and pickup scheduling, and only some locations can complete a same-day buy.
catches: The 3-10 day average includes document approval and scheduling - it is not instant.

repeatable.cadence: You can only sell each vehicle once - this is a one-time payout per car, not recurring income.

who_pays: Carvana - the company pays you directly for your vehicle.
who_qualifies: You must own the vehicle (have the title) with valid ID, and your documents must be approved. Liens must be handled before sale.
work_available: Yes - Carvana was buying vehicles as of 2026-09-23. Only some locations can complete a same-day buy; the average complete sale takes 3-10 days.
what_gets_accepted: The offer can change if the vehicle does not match your description at verification. Have your title and documents ready before starting - paperwork delays are the main slowdown.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees are stated in the verified evidence. Your unpaid time is uploading documents, scheduling pickup or drop-off, and waiting through the 3-10 day average window for approval and scheduling.
when_cash_arrives: Real money - payment follows verification and pickup/drop-off. Average complete sale is 3-10 days from offer to payment; some locations can buy the same day.
